label: TP
reason: The guard condition (500 / 42) + num > 200 evaluates to true (207 > 200), ensuring the user parameter flows directly to bar. This parameter is concatenated into the SQL query string and passed to JDBCtemplate.batchUpdate(), executing the injection. Although encodeForHTML is used for logging, the SQL execution constitutes a confirmed vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input flows to bar, guard is always true, SQL string constructed with bar and executed via batchUpdate
